items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Griffin was on tenor... We went on the road a couple of weeks with that band... Johnny Griffin, who I had met and had played with in Joe Morris's band

ctx.x: Mm hmm. You also recorded, this was around 1948, ’47, with Johnny Griffin’s album “Fly Mister, Fly.” Do you remember that?

No, I don’t remember that specific album, but in 1948, after we came back and didn’t have much to work with Maggie, I was with Joe Morris’s band, who was a rhythm and blues trumpet player. And you wanna know who was in that band? Philly Joe Jones was the drummer, Johnny Griffin was on tenor, and another fast playing tenor player, his name was Wally Something, I can’t think of his last name.
And this was a rhythm and blues band?
